all_missing_session: train-fitted imputation; mean fallback only if training has no retained columns; keep in primary scored population
allocation_policy: fixed ten-person sample of numerically ordered record-audited pool; no scenario/outcome/quality balancing or replacement after outcomes
blinding: freeze training data/code/preprocessing and12 models before final payload processing; hash120 predictions before questionnaire release; do not parse/print reserved scores in acquisition or feature stages
external_history: pending answer; local evidence is bounded, not proof of global non-exposure
failed_recordings: retain scheduled participants/tasks/windows; unsupported features null; no frame synthesis/gap repair; freeze schedule/failure adapter before reserved processing
final_fit: fit each of six fixed models for each of two outcomes once on all six development sessions; no LOPO ensemble and no final participant in fitting
identity_failures: quarantine mismatched/duplicate/unsafe files; retain audit, no silent renaming or participant substitution
missing_outcome: never impute y; keep scheduled inventory and report unscorable denominator; no replacements
other_metrics: paired absolute-error difference versus training mean
pipeline_gate: pilot/features/session-regression CLIs currently engineering/six-person-only; no relabeling final as pilot; minimal explicit-role export/final-inference extension with hidden-label tests required before processing
population: one released protocol session per participant; previously exposed participants excluded from final

preprocessing.train_all_missing: drop training-all-missing columns; mean fallback if none retained

sources: official DataPort HTML public listing read without participant payloads; exact entries and snapshots private

summaries.missingness: mean over observed original window fractions/flags
summaries.task_support: reported separately, never used as anxiety label
summaries.value_features: median over observed original windows, pooled over all three retained tasks

uncertainty_intervals: none; descriptive ten-person bounded independent evaluation, not a powered confirmatory study
